title: Psychology, B.S. — Business Option (University College)
notes: Historical year 2022-2023. Pattern B companion file to PSYCHBA-2022.json. The B.S. at Brandywine offered both Business and Science options; this historical file represents the Business Option as published in the 2022-2023 bulletin archive. Scraper output (ok:true, archive URL: bulletins.psu.edu/archive/2022-2023/undergraduate/colleges/university-college/psychology-bs/) shows the published plan, which specified 'Business Option Course' placeholders for 6 semesters without enumerating specific course codes in the bulletin table itself (unlike the 2026 Science Option which explicitly names ANTH 21/22, BBH 101, etc., and unlike other recent Psychology updates that expanded option-course enumeration). All course codes used here come from the scraper's 'linked_codes' field (PSYCH 100, ENGL 15, ENGL 30H, PSYCH 301W, CAS 100, ENGL 202A) or are marked as generic slots per the scraper's is_generic_slot designation. Unverified code flagged by scraper: CAS 100 (listed as linked but did not resolve to a course record at time of scrape). Total credits per bulletin: 116-119 (plan shown adds up to 116, allowing flexibility in per-semester General Education and Elective selections). Entrance to major requires 2.0 GPA, per the 2022-2023 bulletin archive. QA FIX (2022-09-18, reviewer #2): the scraper correctly reported the bulletin's "PSYCH 200 or STAT 200" plan-grid cell as un-hyperlinked (is_generic_slot=True) for this program/year, but the label unambiguously names two real, catalog-verified courses -- it was originally modeled as a generic slot (only a text label, no options), which meant build_full_plan never actually enrolled the student in either course, so PSYCH 301W (whose real prereq is PSYCH 100 AND (PSYCH 200 or STAT 200)) could never schedule. Fixed to type=course with options ["PSYCH 200","STAT 200"], matching how the pre-existing PSYCHBSBW-2026.json already models this same requirement. That fix then surfaced a second, real, previously-masked gap: PSYCH 200 itself also requires MATH 21 (prereq_groups AND-of-ORs: PSYCH 100 AND MATH 21) per catalogs/psych_catalog.json, which this bulletin's suggested-plan table never lists -- added MATH 21 as a bolt-on Semester 1 course item (same placement-gate convention already used in BUSINESS/ETI/HCDD/PSYCHBABW-2022..2025), bumping Semester 1 target_credits from 13.5 to 16.5. Re-ran build_full_plan(start_year=2022, today=date(2022,7,1), grad_years=4): 0 warnings, goal met, confirmed after fix.

items.label: MATH 21 (real prereq gate for PSYCH 200/STAT 200, same placement-gate fix already used in BUSINESS/ETI/HCDD/PSYCHBABW)
